name: plextrac-api
description: Skill for the PlexTrac penetration-testing and reporting platform API: REST v1/v2/v3 routes (clients, reports, findings, assets, writeups, narratives, assessments, scheduler, users, RBAC, integrations), the Runbooks GraphQL endpoint and outbound webhooks. Includes an OpenAPI 3.1 spec generated from the official Postman collection, a GraphQL operation catalog, object-shape and pagination references, the deprecation log, and a dependency-free Python client with the streaming scanner-import flow.
